item.title: Gifts World Expo Mumbai and Paperworld Mumbai 2026 Set for 26–28 February at Bombay Exhibition Center
item.description: Gifts World Expo Mumbai and Paperworld Mumbai will run from 26–28 February 2026 at the Bombay Exhibition Center, highlighting innovation and growth across India’s gifting and stationery sectors.

item.title: Mahamagham Mahotsav 2026 Concludes After 17-Day Revival of Sacred Tradition at Thirunavaya
item.description: Mahamagham Mahotsav 2026 concluded after 17 days in Thirunavaya, drawing over two million devotees and marking the revival of a centuries-old spiritual tradition.

item.title: Deltin Elevates Goa Street Race Experience as Official Entertainment Partner
item.description: Deltin partnered as the official Entertainment Partner for the Goa Street Circuit, integrating premium hospitality and immersive experiences into the Indian Racing Festival weekend.

item.title: SIMBA Uproar 2026 to Bring Hip-Hop, FMX Stunts and No-VIP Concert Format to Mumbai on 22 March
item.description: SIMBA Uproar 2026 will take place on 22 March at Mumbai’s MMRDA Grounds, featuring hip-hop acts, FMX stunts and a single-tier Rs 699 ticket format with no VIP zones.

item.title: Shriram Shankarlal Music Festival 2026 to Return to New Delhi from 6–8 March
item.description: The Shriram Shankarlal Music Festival will be held from 6–8 March 2026 in New Delhi, presenting three days of Indian classical music across generations and gharanas.

item.title: GamingCon Bharat 2026 to Return to Mumbai for Third Edition in October
item.description: GamingCon Bharat will return to Mumbai on 17–18 October at NESCO, bringing together gamers, creators, brands and esports professionals for its third edition.

item.title: A Decade of Stories, A Future of Empathy: Roshan Abbas on 10 Years of Spoken Fest

item.title: NeoNiche Marks 15-Year Milestone with Focus on Experiential Growth and Strategic Expansion
item.description: NeoNiche has completed 15 years of operations, reporting steady growth and expansion across multiple verticals while outlining plans for its next phase of strategic development.

item.title: TTK Prestige Showcases Kitchen Innovation at HT City Unwind Delhi 2025
item.description: TTK Prestige showcased its latest Triply cookware range and Endura 6-Jar Mixer Grinder at HT City Unwind Delhi 2025, engaging audiences through live culinary demonstrations and immersive brand experiences.

item.title: Percept ICE Showcases Innovation Across Swadesh, Hamleys, Kylie and Global Trade Platforms
item.description: Percept ICE has delivered a series of bespoke exhibition environments for brands including Swadesh, Hamleys, Kylie X Cosmic 2.0 and Jio World Convention Centre across major Indian and global platforms.
